## Summary

Fixes #1616

This PR preserves GitHub issue-closing links when a temporary auto-restart session edits a pull request description after the initial result verification pass.

## Root Cause

PR #1615 initially had `Fixes #1614`, and `verifyResults()` confirmed it. A later Codex auto-restart rewrote the PR body with `gh pr edit --body-file -` and omitted the closing keyword. Temporary watch mode then pushed committed changes and skipped duplicate log upload without re-running PR issue-link enforcement.

A secondary bug made auto-PR link verification noisy: GraphQL closing issue numbers were parsed as strings, but compared directly with a numeric `issueNumber`.

## Changes

- Add shared PR issue-link helpers in `src/pr-issue-linking.lib.mjs`.
- Refactor `verifyResults()` to use the shared PR body issue-link enforcement.
- Re-check the PR issue link after temporary auto-restart watch mode finishes.
- Normalize GraphQL closing issue numbers before comparing them.
- Add a regression test for the issue #1616 failure mode and include it in `npm test`.
- Add the requested case study and raw evidence under `docs/case-studies/issue-1616`.

## Verification

- `node tests/test-issue-1616-pr-issue-link-preservation.mjs`
- `npm test`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh` on dependency-free checkout state
- `bash scripts/check-mjs-syntax.sh`
- `node scripts/validate-changeset.mjs`

## Notes

`npm ci` warns in this workspace because the local Node is v20.20.2 while the package declares Node >=24.0.0. The same commands still passed locally after dependencies were installed.
title: Preserve PR issue links after Codex auto-restart
